claims.statement: The Tree Navigator comprises index tables and visual graph canvases such as the Individuals Index and Pedigree Canvas to allow researchers to browse, sort, search, and navigate individuals in the tree.
The Details Panel serves as the comprehensive property inspector and editor for selected entities, housing editable form attributes, event panels, and relationship panels.
The Person Picker is a reusable combobox component featuring debounced prefix search and ID exclusion support used across dialogs and workflows.
